events.title: Night Night — Theatre
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts — Surfers Paradise
events.description: An experimental theatrical production at HOTA, exploring themes developed by Arielle Gray, Luke Kerridge & Tim Watts, with music by Rachel Claudio. The show runs across the weekend with multiple sessions, including an Auslan interpreted performance.

events.title: HOTA Wednesday Workshop
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts — Bundall
events.description: Part of HOTA's ongoing series, this workshop offers a chance to engage in creative or practical skills. Specific topics vary, encouraging participants to check the HOTA website for details.

events.title: HOTA Dining & Cooking Workshop
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts — Bundall
events.description: A hands-on culinary experience focused on dining and cooking, part of HOTA's recurring winter series. Participants learn new techniques and enjoy food in a social setting.

events.title: HOTA Gallery Exhibition
events.description: An ongoing major art exhibition at the HOTA Gallery showcasing contemporary art. Visitors can explore various artworks and installations throughout the week.

events.title: HOTA Gallery Exhibition & Dining
events.description: A unique experience combining an art exhibition with a curated dining experience at the HOTA Gallery. Explore contemporary art and enjoy a meal in an inspiring setting.

events.title: HOTA Workshops, Talks & Ideas
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts — Bundall
events.description: An ongoing series offering a variety of workshops and intellectually stimulating talks focused on creative and cultural topics. Check the HOTA website for specific daily events within this series.

events.title: Bond University Open Day
events.description: Explore Bond University's campus with faculty tours, student-guided walks, and academic Q&A sessions across various fields. Features thought-provoking talks and food trucks for a community-oriented atmosphere.

events.title: Bond Together Run Club
events.description: A social morning run club hosted by BUSA as part of the Bond Together wellness program. This free community event encourages outdoor activity and connection among participants.

events.title: Bond Together Big Brekkie
events.location: Bond Institute of Health & Sport (BIHS) — Robina
events.description: A free community breakfast event aimed at fostering connection and social interaction among Bond University students and the wider community. Part of the Bond Together wellness initiative.

events.title: LuminaX Accelerator Demo Night
events.description: A startup accelerator demo night where founders pitch their new ventures and innovations. This event is ideal for curious, entrepreneurial, and tech-minded individuals interested in the local startup ecosystem.

events.title: Sourdough Bread Workshop
events.description: A hands-on workshop focused on the craft of making sourdough bread from scratch. Participants will learn fermentation techniques and baking skills in a community setting.

events.title: It's ON ChevrON Street Party
events.location: Thomas Drive, Chevron Island, Gold Coast
events.description: A vibrant community street party activating Chevron Island with street food, local stalls, and a lively social atmosphere. Celebrate the neighbourhood's artsy, café-culture vibe.

events.title: NaturallyGC Free Outdoor Events
events.location: Various outdoor locations across Gold Coast
events.description: A series of free outdoor activities and education workshops focused on connecting with and conserving the Gold Coast's natural environment. Includes bushwalks, nature education, and conservation events.

events.title: Abedian School of Architecture Lecture Series: Lecture 3
events.location: Bond University, Abedian School of Architecture — Robina
events.description: The third lecture in Bond University's prestigious architecture series, featuring leading architects and design thinkers. Expect discussions on contemporary architectural theory and practice, followed by Q&A.
